_note: Brand FACTS only. These are fixed because they are the brand, not because they are a design opinion. Everything about layout, composition, motion, imagery and art direction is yours to invent.
name: NEXO

color._note: The one official brand colour, from the printed colour chip. Build whatever palette you want around it — this value itself never changes.

typeface._note: The wordmark's face, supplied as woff2/ttf and also on Google Fonts. Available in Light 300 only, and it breaks below ~28px. Use it, ignore it, or pair it with anything — your call. Body typeface is entirely your choice.

wordmark.construction: NE over XO, with an infinity glyph tucked between the two lines
wordmark._rule: Never re-typeset, re-space, rotate, outline or recolour outside the supplied variants.

productSystem._rule: The +1 / +2 / +3 marks are part of the product names and the logic of the range. Keep them. How you draw them is up to you.
